bd-foh8.1 CLOSED. Commits b8a93d1 (P11.1) + 3438ba4 (P11.2 restore).

GATES (all GREEN): reservation_acquired fires when a 30031 acquired; reservation_released fires on release marker ONLY (never on acquire); reaction_added on kind-7; message_posted on user kind-14; stamped workflow-emitted events rejected end-to-end (loop prevention).

THE REAL GAP (found via TDD): the raw-bus run_trigger_loop subscribed with an EMPTY filter = GLOBAL subscription — the A3 access gate excludes every project-scoped event (30031, kind-7) from global subs. The loop was dead code with zero production call sites. Fix: Bus::subscribe_trusted (A3 gate bypass, mailbox-internal consumers only) + run_trigger_loop subscribes trusted.

LANDED: trigger_filter.rs ingress evaluation (matches_trigger w/ acquired-released disambiguation + project/path/channel/emoji scoping, trigger_payload + reservation status, trigger_run_id); server.rs arms spawn_trigger_loop alongside the mail loop on serve paths (production-live); host consumes the moved fns.

EVIDENCE: toron-workflow 132P/0F (+5), toron-mcp 37+5+7+1P (+gate test), toron-core 363P/0F (+trusted-sub test), e2e green, clippy clean on touched files.

ALERT: daemon auto-commits 150f182/1aa0571/ec2006c REVERTED P11.2 from git; restored in 3438ba4 (git now matches the tree). Watch the auto-commit sweep.

Locks + cargo slot released. bd-foh8.3 still mine (in_progress; flywheel coalition.rs tree fixed + compiles).
